components.desc_zh: 引导链、TNX 加载器、内核、Shell。这是操作系统本体。成品二进制（VHD）在每个版本的 Releases 页面上。
components.desc_en: Boot chain, TNX loader, kernel, shell. Built binaries (VHD) are attached to each release.

versions.subject_zh: 自研 FAT12/16/32 取代 FatFs（跨簇读取会交出错数据，导致程序映像被写坏）；发行改 VHD（动态扩展）；控制台写入原子化
versions.subject_en: Own FAT12/16/32 replaces FatFs (the port corrupted images when reading across clusters); releases ship as VHD (dynamically expanding); atomic console updates

versions.subject_zh: TNX 1.1（架构标识）、点阵 ASCII 字体、多盘符挂载
versions.subject_en: TNX 1.1 (machine tag), bitmap ASCII font, multiple drive letters

versions.subject_zh: 中文上屏；控制台服务层与自有 framebuffer 后端；API v2.4 批量原语；定时器
versions.subject_en: Chinese on screen; console service layer with a framebuffer backend; API v2.4 batch primitives; timer

versions.subject_zh: 控制台服务层 + 自有 framebuffer 后端；内嵌 8x12 点阵字体
versions.subject_en: Console service layer and an own framebuffer backend; embedded 8x12 bitmap font

versions.subject_zh: 控制台换行翻译、API v2.x（颜色 / 光标 / 文件 / 目录）、外部命令、TNX 程序
versions.subject_en: Console newline handling; API v2.x (colours, cursor, file and directory I/O); external commands

versions.subject_zh: TNX 加载器 + 裸程序名执行；工具链拆到独立仓库
versions.subject_en: TNX loader; run programs by bare name; toolchain split out

versions.subject_zh: 早期快照（与 v0.3.0 同一提交）

components.desc_zh: 写 TNX 程序和驱动需要的头文件、运行时、链接脚本、样例。不需要内核源码。
components.desc_en: Headers, runtime, linker script and examples for writing TNX programs and drivers.

versions.subject_zh: 驱动 SDK（每个驱动独立产物、1 MiB 窗口槽）；constest 控制台压力样例；udtest 异常帧自检样例；FatFs 已移除，文件 API 全走自研 FAT
versions.subject_en: Driver SDK (each driver a separate artifact with a 1 MiB window slot); constest console stress sample; udtest trap-frame self-test; FatFs removed, all file APIs now use our own FAT driver

versions.subject_zh: 自包含 SDK：API v2.x、printf、文件 / 目录 API、驱动运行时
versions.subject_en: Self-contained SDK: API v2.x, printf, file/dir API, driver runtime

components.desc_zh: 宿主机工具：tnxpack（ELF64 转 TNX）、tnxdump（检查器）、mkfat（FAT16 映像）。

versions.subject_zh: tnxpack / tnxdump 支持 TNX 1.1；tnxdump 的程序基址跟上内核（0x2800000）
versions.subject_en: tnxpack / tnxdump understand TNX 1.1; tnxdump follows the kernel's program base (0x2800000)

components.desc_zh: 外部命令：EXECOM、MORE、FIND、FC、TREE、ATTRIB、EDIT。每个都是 TNX 程序。
components.desc_en: External commands, each a TNX program.

versions.subject_zh: TREE 画成真树；EDIT 四色分区 + 光标可见 + Insert/覆盖模式
versions.subject_en: TREE draws a real tree; EDIT gains four colour zones, a visible cursor and an insert/overwrite mode

versions.subject_zh: 七个外部命令，含 EXECOM 与全屏 EDIT
versions.subject_en: Seven external commands including EXECOM and a full-screen EDIT
